disposition_reason: Primary field survey printing Cd, Pb, total Hg and Zn statistics in fresh mass for wild edible mushroom species by site.

study.design: Field survey of wild edible mushrooms (200 samples, 10 species) from industrial (zinc smelter and zinc-lead mining/metallurgy) and non-industrial forest areas
study.origin: Wild-growing; Szydlowiec and Wadowice counties (non-industrial), Tarnowskie Gory and Olkusz counties (industrial), southern Poland
study.method: Microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion; Cd and Pb by ET-AAS, total Hg by CV-AFS, Zn by ICP-OES; duplicate analyses
study.qa: Calibration with certified standard solutions; no matrix certified reference material or recovery reported
